subject: PlaceCom Weekly | Everything You Need to Know!
html:
Welcome to PlaceCom Weekly!

Welcome to PlaceCom Weekly, a short and simple newsletter designed to keep you updated and on track.

We know things can sometimes feel overwhelming with multiple deadlines, requirements, sessions, and updates happening throughout the semester. That's where the Weekly comes in.

Every week, we'll bring you: Important deadlines you shouldn't miss, upcoming sessions & our Saturday Save rescources!

-  PlaceCom Comms History Doc: PlaceCom_CommunicationHistory_PublicDocument  
 Please refer to this doc to access all previously communicated details from both CDO and PlaceCom.
- The Saturday Save: Sector-wise Guidebook  
Find the most useful PlaceCom resource for this week, here. 

Important Updates for CPP

  1. LinkedIn Learning Deadline

  • The deadline to complete the first 2 mandatory LinkedIn Learning courses has been extended to 15th August.

  • The deadline to complete all 4 mandatory LinkedIn Learning courses is 30th August.

  • Please note that failure to complete the first 2 courses by 15th August will affect your placement enrollment. We encourage you to complete the courses well before the deadline.

  1. Office Hours with PlaceCom

  • Office Hours are now available here for students who would like guidance on placement-related queries or feedback on their resumes.

  • If you are booking an Office Hour for resume feedback, please email your resume to the assigned panel member at least 6 hours before your scheduled slot so they have sufficient time to review it beforehand

  1. Mock Interviews

  • Mock interview slots will take place on Saturdays and Sundays for students who have completed their resume review.

  • Slots will open every Wednesday at 6:00 PM.

  1. Resume Review Slots

  • Resume review slots will continue to open every Wednesday at 6:00 PM.

  • Slots will continue to be released until the end of August.

  1. Office Hours with CDO Team

  • The Career Prep Team's 1:1 Office Hours are now live and can be booked through AMS under Student Support → Advising Hub: Office Hours → Career Prep Program.

  • These sessions are intended to help you discuss career goals, explore roles, organisations or sectors, review draft resumes, and receive guidance on your preparation strategy.

  • Please note that these Office Hours are separate from the mandatory resume review sessions and mock interviews required as part of the placement process. Students are requested to book their slots at least 24 hours in advance.

For any doubts or support, reach out to us through the PlaceCom Chatroom or email us at connect.placecom@ashoka.edu.in. We're always just a message away. 🤍
